The name "Red Shirts" is used to describe the volunteers who served Giuseppe Garibaldi in his struggle to forge the loose Italian city-states into a nation-state. They were so named because Garibaldi and his fighters wore red shirts. The charismatic Garibaldi was renowned at home and abroad, widely regarded as a freedom fighter dedicated to uniting Italy under the Sardinian crown. These Italian pan-nationalists fought for the unification of Italy.

$MONARCHTITLE$! News has reached us! The famous Italian freedom fighter Giuseppe Garibaldi and his "Expedition of the Thousand" have defeated and taken control of the government of $FROMCOUNTRY$. Wherever this powerful freedom fighter goes, he is welcomed by cheering Italian crowds waving the Italian tricolor flag — the liberator of all Italy. Due to our dominant position on the peninsula, the newly formed government of $FROMCOUNTRY$ has sent word that the nascent Italy will recognize the existing position of $COUNTRY$.

As we mentioned before, when a pop with an attached brigade revolts, the brigade will also revolt. If a brigade has a rebel icon behind its population icon, it means the pop it belongs to is a member of a rebel faction. This is very dangerous. One way to confirm the status of this pop and its political views is to click on the pop icon in the unit interface to open the population interface. Now, click next to continue.

Prices on the global market are set daily based on changes in supply and demand. Current supply and demand set a target price that the actual price will constantly approach. You must pay close attention to the development of commodity prices, which is very important for you. When the price of small arms rises, it may be time to build a new factory. The arrow next to the price indicates whether the price is rising (green), stable (yellow), or falling (red). Click next to continue.

The image below shows an example of a sailing ship on the world market. The icon at the bottom shows whether we are currently selling or buying this resource, and whether the trade is conducted automatically by AI or not. The government (player or AI) can buy or sell on the market in two ways: by setting trade rules or through automatic trade. Click on the sailing ship icon to observe an automatic trade.

The Newlands Resolution was a joint resolution passed by the US Congress in 1898, named after Congressman Francis G. Newlands. It annexed the Republic of Hawaii to the United States, acquiring the territory of Hawaii.

Britain acquired sovereignty over the Ionian Islands after the Napoleonic Wars. In 1862, the cost of maintaining sovereignty was considered too high relative to their value, and after two years of negotiations, they were ceded to Greece.

As a consequence of the Crimean War, Russia began to believe there was no hope of retaining its North American territories in another war with Britain, and sought to sell them, which became the state of Alaska in the United States. This territory was purchased by the United States in 1867 at a price of $0.023 per acre. After being championed and completed by then-Secretary of State William Henry Seward, the purchase of Alaska was widely mocked by Americans as "Seward's Folly."

The probe made by Eduard Andreevich Stoeckl, our chargé d'affaires at the embassy in Washington, has yielded results. The United States indicated today that negotiations can begin on the sale of our North American territories. The Americans have offered us $0.023 per acre for the Alaska region, which seems relatively fair. It will be difficult for the colony to survive a war with Britain, so selling it now at this price is not a bad idea. What do you think, $MONARCHTITLE$?
No, I don't think so. Perhaps someday we can build a bridge there?

The term "Sepoy" derives from the Persian "Siphai", meaning soldier, and was commonly used to refer to Indian soldiers serving European powers. In 1857, some sepoys employed by the British East India Company launched a mutiny against British rule, an event known simultaneously as the "Indian Mutiny" and the "First War of Independence." The mutinous soldiers fought to liberate India from colonial rule.
